ops.text: `ccx vcs diff uv.lock` reported "No changes" while `git diff --stat uv.lock` showed 3 insertions (the UV_EXCLUDE_NEWER `[options] exclude-newer` block) and `git diff -- uv.lock` printed the hunk. The capt-hook guard rewrote my `git diff uv.lock` to the ccx form, so the false "No changes" nearly made me commit a polluted lockfile — the positional path arg seems to be parsed as a source revision rather than a path filter, or lockfiles are silently excluded from the structural summary. Either way, a dirty tracked file should never come back as "No changes".
